instruction: Add all my coworkers and friends as friends on venmo, if they are not already.
notes: The actual number of coworker/friend contacts is unknown before runtime, so the problem uses placeholder persons: coworker-1 and friend-1 (to be added) and coworker-2 (already a Venmo friend, so it must be skipped). At runtime the agent repeats venmo.add_friend for every coworker/friend contact email not already in the venmo.search_friends list. Facts in :init such as has-relationship, contact-email and the existing friendship are world-state facts, not agent knowledge; agent knowledge is gated by (contacts-searched ?r) (from phone.search_contacts with the relationship filter) and (venmo-friends-checked) (from venmo.search_friends). Phone login uses the supervisor's phone number as username; Venmo uses the email. Because quantified goals are disallowed, supervisor-complete-task takes the task-record persons as non-API parameters so its precondition equals the per-person goal conjunction; the goal in the problem pins the concrete persons. Relationship filter strings assumed to be 'coworker' and 'friend' (phone.show_contact_relationships can confirm if needed).
